cases.expected: JsonSchema instance is returned and its root node matches the JSON content of simple-schema.json
cases.description: A well‑formed classpath URI that points to an existing JSON schema file. The method should resolve the URI, read the schema and return a non‑null JsonSchema object.

cases.expected: JsonSchema instance is returned and its root node matches the JSON content of external-schema.json
cases.description: A file‑system URI that points to a readable schema file. The method should use the default SchemaLoader to load the file and return a valid JsonSchema.

group: Invalid URI – malformed or unsupported scheme

cases.expected: java.net.URISyntaxException thrown before getSchema(URI) is invoked
cases.description: The URI string is syntactically invalid; construction of the URI itself fails, so getSchema is never called.

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException with message containing "Unsupported schema URI scheme"
cases.description: The URI uses a scheme that the factory does not know how to resolve (e.g., mailto). The method should detect this and throw an IllegalArgumentException.

cases.expected: NullPointerException thrown
cases.description: Passing a null URI should cause a NullPointerException because the implementation immediately calls schemaUri.toString().

cases.expected: JsonSchemaException (or IOException) indicating that the resource could not be found
cases.description: The URI is syntactically correct but points to a resource that does not exist on the classpath. The method should attempt to load it and propagate a meaningful exception.

cases.expected: JsonSchemaException (or IOException) indicating file not found
cases.description: A file‑system URI that refers to a file that cannot be read. The method should surface the I/O problem.

cases.expected: JsonSchema instance whose configuration reflects the defaults created by createSchemaValidatorsConfig() (e.g., $ref handling enabled)
cases.description: Ensures that getSchema(URI) forwards the default SchemaValidatorsConfig produced by createSchemaValidatorsConfig() to the underlying loader.

cases.expected: JsonSchema instance is returned and its root node matches the JSON content served by the HTTP endpoint
cases.description: A well‑formed HTTP URI that points to an accessible JSON schema served by a mock HTTP server. The method should perform an HTTP GET, read the response, and return a valid JsonSchema.

cases.expected: JsonSchemaException (or IOException) indicating that the remote resource could not be retrieved (HTTP 404)
cases.description: The HTTP endpoint returns a 404 status. The factory should surface the I/O problem rather than returning a null schema.

cases.expected: JsonSchema instance is returned and its root node matches the JSON content of simple-schema.json (fragment is ignored)
cases.description: A classpath URI that includes a fragment. The fragment should not affect schema loading; the factory should strip it and load the underlying resource.

cases.expected: JsonSchema instance is returned and its root node matches the JSON content of simple-schema.json (query is ignored)
cases.description: A classpath URI that contains a query string. The loader should ignore the query part and successfully load the schema.

cases.expected: JsonSchemaException (or IOException) indicating that the schema content is empty or cannot be parsed
cases.description: The referenced file exists but contains no characters. The factory should attempt to parse it and fail with a clear exception.

cases.expected: JsonSchemaException (or IOException) indicating JSON parsing error
cases.description: The file exists but contains malformed JSON (e.g., missing commas). The method should throw an exception that reflects the parsing problem.

group: Caching – repeated calls with same URI

cases.expected: The second invocation of getSchema(URI) returns the same JsonSchema instance (reference equality) as the first call
cases.description: JsonSchemaFactory caches loaded schemas in a ConcurrentMap. Verify that calling getSchema with an identical URI reuses the cached JsonSchema rather than creating a new object.

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException with message containing "Unsupported schema URI scheme" or "Relative URIs are not supported"
cases.description: A URI without a scheme (relative path) is supplied. The factory expects absolute URIs and should reject the input with an appropriate exception.

cases.expected: JsonSchema instance is returned and its root node matches the JSON content of simple-schema.json inside the JAR
cases.description: A JAR URL points to a schema packaged within a JAR file. The loader should be able to resolve the resource and return a valid JsonSchema.

cases.expected: JsonSchema instance is returned; validation of a sample JSON document that follows the $ref resolves the external schema correctly
cases.description: The primary schema contains a $ref to another schema located via a classpath URI. Verify that getSchema loads both schemas and that the resulting JsonSchema can resolve the reference during validation.

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException with message containing "Unsupported schema URI scheme"
cases.description: The URI uses the FTP scheme which the factory does not support. The method should detect the unsupported scheme and throw an IllegalArgumentException.

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException with message containing "Unsupported schema URI scheme"
cases.description: A data URI embeds the schema directly. The factory does not handle data URIs and must reject it with an IllegalArgumentException.

cases.expected: JsonSchemaException (or IOException) indicating that the target is not a readable schema file
cases.description: The URI points to a directory rather than a regular file. When the loader attempts to read it, it should fail and propagate an appropriate exception.

cases.expected: JsonSchemaException (or IOException) caused by a connection failure (e.g., UnknownHostException)
cases.description: The HTTP URI refers to a host that cannot be resolved or contacted. The factory should surface the I/O problem rather than returning a schema.

cases.expected: JsonSchemaException (or IllegalStateException) indicating a circular reference or recursion limit exceeded
cases.description: The referenced schema contains a $ref that ultimately points back to itself, forming a cycle. The factory must detect the circular reference and throw a clear exception.

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException with message containing "Unsupported schema version"
cases.description: The schema declares a $schema IRI that does not correspond to any known draft (e.g., "http://json-schema.org/draft-99/schema#"). The factory should reject it with an IllegalArgumentException.

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException with message containing "Schema location must not be empty"
cases.description: An empty URI string is syntactically valid but provides no location information. The factory should treat this as an illegal argument and throw an IllegalArgumentException.
